lean.statement:
∀
  {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup.{u_1} E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace.{0, u_1} ℝ E]
  [inst_2 : CompleteSpace.{u_1} E] {f : E → ℝ} {β h : ℝ} {z : E},
  IsMinOn.{u_1, 0} f Set.univ.{u_1} z →
    LT.lt.{0} 0 h →
      LE.le.{0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} β h) 1 →
        (∀ (x y : E),
            LE.le.{0} (f y)
              (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (f x) (inner.{0, u_1} ℝ (gradient.{0, u_1} f x) (HSub.hSub.{u_1, u_1, u_1} y x)))
                (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} β 2)
                  (HPow.hPow.{0, 0, 0} (norm.{u_1} (HSub.hSub.{u_1, u_1, u_1} y x)) 2)))) →
          ∀ (x₀ : E) {N : ℕ},
            LT.lt.{0} 0 N →
              ∃ k,
                Membership.mem.{0, 0} (Finset.range N) k ∧
                  LE.le.{0}
                    (norm.{u_1}
                      (gradient.{0, u_1} f
                        (Nat.iterate.{u_1 + 1}
                          (fun x => HSub.hSub.{u_1, u_1, u_1} x (HSMul.hSMul.{0, u_1, u_1} h (gradient.{0, u_1} f x))) k
                          x₀)))
                    √(HDiv.hDiv.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (HSub.hSub.{0, 0, 0} (f x₀) (f z)))
                        (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (↑N) h))
approved_definition_context: gradient f x is the Riesz vector of the totalized Frechet derivative; the notation itself does not impose differentiability.
IsMinOn f Set.univ z means f(z)<=f(x) for every x in the entire domain.
Nat.iterate T n x is the n-fold iterate T^[n](x); at n=0 it equals x.
Finset.range N is the finite set of natural numbers k with k<N; Real.sqrt is the nonnegative square root, totalized as zero at negative arguments.
